name: anvilts
description: Repository-aware safety and progress verification for concurrent systems using labelled transition systems.

interface.longDescription: Inspect concurrent code with Codex, review a source-linked finite abstraction with the user, then deterministically check deadlocks, safety properties, and LTSA-style fair-choice progress with auditable diagnostics and SVG state graphs.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and verify a concurrency risk with AnviLTS.
Model this concurrent protocol and check it for deadlocks.
